findings.text: blocking: baseline_suite and after_suite carry "command":"x", "log_path":"/x" and an unterminated after_suite object where the done_when requires each arm as inline JSON with a full 40-character revision, so the arm measure cannot be read, re-run or reconciled from the record and the placeholders read as passing arms beside a real failure_count of 0 on the base; the node's own contract refuses it as "after_suite must be an inline JSON object" and "baseline_suite.log_path log '/x' resolves outside the run directory" (logs/reviewed-manifest-check.log, EXIT=1), so the run cannot land on this record as it stands.

non-blocking: _entry_commits_strict duplicates the body of _entry_commits at reckon/crew/promotion_scope.py:429 instead of extending that owner with the strict keyword _resolve_commit already carries, so the two readers can drift and a later change to the citation grammar has two places to land in.

non-blocking: the gate the manifest calls the head run names revision 857b8298b87b2a514b816c8dd8c2202266dd5ca1, not the delivered head e5bd3c65ba06691d23f1a6e84fdcc6a78af43f33, and ran in place rather than as an all_debug job, so the "passes in full at head as a job on all_debug" clause rests on the parent revision and the disclosed bwrap instrument fault rather than on the revision being promoted.
